{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cg495CvWWD4aW6gek6Be5","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01R1mXvekfwj5Csa8QEkyoh5","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 -I -c \"\nimport csv\nfrom collections import defaultdict,deque\nrows=list(csv.DictReader(open('/app/dataset/hospital_compensation_registry.csv')))\nby={r['patient_id']:r for r in rows}\nadj=defaultdict(set)\nfor r in rows:\n    a,b=r['patient_id'],r['emergency_contact_patient_id']\n    adj[a].add(b); adj[b].add(a)\ndef bfs(s):\n    d={s:0}; q=deque([s])\n    while q:\n        u=q.popleft()\n        for v in adj[u]:\n            if v not in d: d[v]=d[u]+1; q.append(v)\n    return d\nnoclaim=set(r['patient_id'] for r in rows if not r['record_date'])\nfor c in ['PAT_265','PAT_033','PAT_006']:\n    d=bfs(c); sur=by[c]['second_name']\n    print('===',c,by[c]['full_name'],by[c]['compensation_reason'])\n    cands=[(d[p],p) for p in noclaim if p in d and d[p]<=3]\n    for dist,p in sorted(cands):\n        mark=' <== SURNAME MATCH' if by[p]['second_name']==sur else ''\n        print('   dist=%d %s %-18s%s'%(dist,p,by[p]['full_name'],mark))\n    print('   all no-claim with surname %s: %s'%(sur,[(p,d.get(p,'inf')) for p in noclaim if by[p]['second_name']==sur]))\n    print()\n\"","description":"Find no-claim neighbors and surname matches per claimant"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1005,"cache_read_input_tokens":42945,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1005,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6523f779-c6f6-4aab-81e7-a2d4b49b62df","uuid":"80eafc34-b74f-481f-b109-e802c9ebdcde","timestamp":"2026-10-15T13:58:16.472Z"}
